notes: Not player-facing at the registered world: the "[Lua] Could not call script %s: Execution failed." branch mudlogs (CMP, LVL_IMMORT) only when a loaded script raises a runtime error; boot-time loads (globals.lua) run before any descriptor exists, and the registered script corpus produces no [Lua] mudlogs in the retained full-census runs (R5e).

Not player-facing in the registered world: the "No such file." branch mudlogs only when a referenced script is missing; every registered Script: reference (mob/room/obj) resolves to an existing file under lib/world/scripts (R5e).

Not player-facing in the registered world: the "Syntax error." branch mudlogs only when a script fails to parse; the registered corpus boots clean with no [Lua] mudlogs in the retained census runs (R5e).
Not player-facing: the "Memory error." branch needs a Lua allocation failure, which no deterministic scenario can produce; the mudlog target is the immortal log channel (R5e).
Not player-facing in the registered world: the "Generic Error." branch mudlogs only on an unspecified lua_dofile failure; the registered corpus boots clean with no [Lua] mudlogs (R5e).
Not player-facing in the registered world: the "Unknown error %d." default arm mudlogs only on an out-of-range lua_dofile code; the registered corpus boots clean with no [Lua] mudlogs (R5e).
